newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo Stock Exchange to set up office in Singapore.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo Stock Exchange to set up office in Singapore.

text.p: The Tokyo Stock Exchange (TSE) will set up an office in Singapore in December, 1996 at the earliest, a TSE spokesman said on Wednesday.
TSE will send two employees from Japan and hire one local employee as in its other two overseas offices in New York and London, the spokesman said.

"Singapore's strategic location, capital, infrastructure and telecommunications system are convenient to exchange information with securities firms in the region, and facilitate communication with the ASEAN (Association of Southeast Asian Nations) members," he said.
